metadata.heading: Test Antigravity — 1000 kVA
facts: Dedicated fire pump tapped ahead of main disconnect (NEC 695.4(B))
7 distribution branches: 2 lighting (208V), 3 mechanical (480V), 1 mechanical (208V), 1 plug load (208V, 2 panels)
3 storeys — floor-banded risers with A-7 level lines on S1

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: utility available fault current not provided (T3-EOR). No available_fc anywhere in this topology, therefore no A-4 fault-current tags are placed and the DV-4 bus-bracing / AIC check cannot run. Switchboard and panelboard AIC ratings are unset pending this value. Affects sw-201, d-301, r-391, r-392.
compositor_halts.blocks: A-4 tags · DV-4 bus bracing / AIC · switchboard + panelboard AIC ratings

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: utility transformer impedance (%Z, X/R) is a utility-provided nameplate value. transformer_impedance_V1_0_0.json covers dry-type distribution units only and has no 1000 kVA row, so pct_z / x_over_r on d-301 are left null rather than fabricated. Affects d-301.
compositor_halts.blocks: Fault-current study at the service entrance

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: feeder distances not provided (T3-EOR). No voltage-drop calculation performed; voltage_drop_pct is absent on every R-1 and no A-5 tags are placed. Affects every R-1 in this topology.

COMPOSITOR_HALT: fire pump breaker rating is provisional (250AF / 250AT). EOR must confirm final overcurrent protection sizing per NEC 695.4(B)(2) locked-rotor current carrying requirements for 4FP-1-A (100 HP, 124 FLA / 725 LRA). Affects d-303, r-302.

compositor_notes.text: 480Y/277V 3PH 4W stated. FLA at 1000 kVA = 1,000,000 / (480 x 1.732) = 1202.8 A. Main breaker is next standard rating above FLA: 1600AF / 1600AT LSIG with GFP (NEC 240.6(A), 230.95). Main and secondary bus 1600 A. Service lateral tag 16004 (6 sets 3 1/2" C, (4)500 AL + 350 AL GND).
Commercial occupancy assumed, 3 storeys, electrical room on Level 1, one normal-power sheet S1. A-7 level lines on Levels 1, 2, and 3.
Fire pump taps main bus ahead of the main service disconnect per NEC 695.4(B) (non-negotiable). Positioned in dedicated fire_pump section between metering and main breaker sections.

Branches arranged B, A, B, A, B, A, B: four 208V transformer-fed branches interleaved with three 480V direct mechanical branches to eliminate adjacent transformer glyph collision risk. Branches: CB-01 250AF/125AT -> 4T-1-A (75 kVA) -> 2L-1-A -> 2L-2-A -> 2L-3-A; CB-02 400AF/400AT -> 4M-1-A -> 4M-2-A -> 4M-3-A; CB-03 250AF/125AT -> 4T-1-B (75 kVA) -> 2L-1-B -> 2L-2-B -> 2L-3-B; CB-04 400AF/400AT -> 4M-1-B -> 4M-2-B -> 4M-3-B; CB-05 250AF/125AT -> 4T-1-P (75 kVA) -> 2P-1-A -> 2P-2-A (2 panels); CB-06 400AF/400AT -> 4M-1-C -> 4M-2-C -> 4M-3-C; CB-07 250AF/125AT -> 4T-1-D (75 kVA) -> 2M-1-D -> 2M-2-D -> 2M-3-D.
Stated scope calls for "2 plug load panels at 208v". Realized as Power Branch A: 75 kVA transformer 4T-1-P feeding 2P-1-A (Level 1) which sub-feeds 2P-2-A (Level 2). Exactly two plug load panels.
Stated: "no emergency system". No generator, ATS, or emergency switchboard modeled.

layout_config.$comment: Embedded copy of antigravity_layout_config.json. Embedded so validator rule CV-14 runs — its capability gate reads topology.layout_config.subfeed_start_ports. Sidecar keys still win at layout time.
